title: The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin before 1.6.2 does not check that the ticket type and price…
description: The Event Tickets Manager for WooCommerce WordPress plugin versions before 1.6.2 contains a vulnerability where unauthenticated AJAX actions do not properly verify that the ticket type and price belong to the event ticket being added to the cart. This flaw allows unauthenticated visitors to purchase event tickets at a lower price configured for a different event.
